usage: graph-audit.py [-h] [--root ROOT]
                      --comparison-kgx-dir COMPARISON_KGX_DIR
                      --receipt RECEIPT --base BASE
                      --gate-receipts GATE_RECEIPTS
                      [--target-sha256 TARGET_SHA256]
                      [--expected-baseline-records EXPECTED_BASELINE_RECORDS]

Audit actual generated PathwayMech SVG pages and KGX artifacts against final
YAML.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT
  --comparison-kgx-dir COMPARISON_KGX_DIR
  --receipt RECEIPT
  --base BASE           Exact reviewed baseline commit; record whether actual
                        merge is still pending
  --gate-receipts GATE_RECEIPTS
  --target-sha256 TARGET_SHA256
  --expected-baseline-records EXPECTED_BASELINE_RECORDS
